construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation authored in the isolated build directory.

shared_schema.input: stage=input, status=ok, results={}, fixture_label starts with SYNTHETIC
shared_schema.output: Same envelope and unchanged data; cumulative validated results; final stage=semantic.
shared_schema.validation: One validate boundary before/after every stage; strict fields, unique ids, referential integrity, timezone-aware dates, finite numbers, exact citation spans and candidate/gap propagation.
shared_schema.citation: document_id, start, end, quote; zero-based half-open Python Unicode character offsets into the original document text.
shared_schema.errors: One JSON object with status=error and an error message; CLI exits 2.

cross_stage_handoffs: behavior -> review: top_k ranked candidate ids, preserving rank order
review -> normal: reviewed document ids, evidence citations, requirement checks and gap ids
normal -> semantic: only reviewed candidate contexts; extractive findings supply index text; exact citations and gaps retained in each hit

behavior.personalization: Current user's view=1 and purchase=3, exponentially decayed by explicit as_of and half_life_days. Other users ignored. Future events rejected. Cold start ranks catalog popularity. Stable ties use popularity then product id.
behavior.review: All requirement keyword tokens must occur in one sentence/newline-delimited passage. Status means only evidence_found or gap; no certification/compliance determination. Negation and truth are not inferred.
behavior.normal: Extractive retrieval scores query token overlap plus gap-keyword overlap and linked requirement evidence. Top_k passages per product; exact spans and requirement links retained.
behavior.semantic: In-memory inverted index over selected catalog text plus retrieved findings; log term frequency and smoothed inverse document frequency. Optional injected text-to-vector callable adds cosine similarity. Behavior score breaks search ties, then id.
behavior.embedding_contract: Callable receives query/product context strings and returns a nonempty finite nonzero numeric list/tuple with fixed dimension. Failures are validation errors. Empty queries skip embeddings. No live provider. Determinism requires a deterministic injected callable.
behavior.empty_cases: Empty catalog yields empty results; missing documents yield traceable gaps; empty query yields zero relevance and behavioral tie-breaking; no requirements is valid.
behavior.boundedness: Behavior and per-product research outputs bounded by top_k. All selected candidates remain search hits, including zero-match hits. Suitable for small fixtures, not adversarial resource exhaustion.

test_outcomes.cli_stdout: One validated JSON object with status=ok and stage=semantic.
coverage: injected embedding fixtures and malformed vectors
